propositions: autodeploy recreates the review-bot container without draining in-flight reviews, killing code reviews mid-execution and causing the LLM-Review gate to live-lock when landing bursts produce deploys faster than reviews complete
the reconciler's retry path is unprotected because review_and_vote runs outside the shutdown queue, so killed reviews cannot self-heal when deploys keep arriving
killed reviews emit no VOTER_ERROR signal, so every health check reads OK while the gate is fully live-locked, creating a blind spot in monitoring
the fix defers deploys when in_flight reviews are detected, bounding deferral to 1800s (1.5x REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) to prevent permanent live-lock from a chronically busy bot
deferral episodes are keyed to avoid timer reset during landing bursts, ensuring a single deploy occurs at the newest tip after the burst ends
in_flight count is exposed on the existing /health endpoint and monitored via new AUTODEPLOY_REVIEW_INTERRUPT alarm to make interruptions observable
